title: Prompt ablation: does the goal+schema system prompt convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion for M-7B-QWEN / M-3B-QWEN under the same credential-free CPU-quantized constraints as EXP-INTEL-37982024058?
question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as the audited parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 (identical minimal task, GBNF grammar, sampling, seeds, model artifacts and harness code path), does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt - condition P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, derived from the grandparent harness SYS prompt (research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37973264582/raw/code/min_webagent.py, file sha256 4e2b6710c78f4e4399a8ed5ae78e0231563fb832b780b80a955bcbc16b046862; the SYS string constant itself has sha256 742e5aae5b5ffd72ccb43cb18658a14483660e7659640df651e91011e9b6dc12) with the single ref->selector schema-alignment adaptation - convert M-7B-QWEN's or M-3B-QWEN's step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion, where the ONLY varied dimension between treatment and comparator cells is prompts.system?
hypothesis: H1 (capability): at least one of M-7B-QWEN (evaluated first) or M-3B-QWEN clears the pre-declared capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5 frozen seeded episodes) under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, thereby converting the parent FALSIFIES (bounded by audit VF-01 to the underspecified-prompt ceiling) into a SUPPORTS at the goal/schema protocol ceiling. H1b (attribution): for each clearing candidate, the contemporaneous within-experiment paired comparator cell under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED (byte-identical to the parent system prompt) fails the bar in the same run, isolating the goal/schema prompt as the driver (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED) rather than a run-level environment artifact.
falsifier: H0: no measurable treatment cell clears the bar (every COMPLETE M-7B-QWEN / M-3B-QWEN treatment cell has task_success_rate < 0.6), i.e., the goal/schema prompt does not convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full completion and the audited VF-01 failure mode (step-0 reveal click, re-click loop, zero answer actions) recurs under the enriched prompt. This is the Director's bounded negative: no credential-free factory-provisionable local CPU-quantized endpoint in the tested 3B-8B Qwen class can complete the minimal multi-step Web-agent task even with a properly specified goal/schema, so readiness condition (3) of the gated four-arm benchmark is not satisfied by this model class and the benchmark must be re-directed to hosted endpoints or a different model class. FALSIFIES is asserted only over the COMPLETE, comparator-valid evaluated candidate set; a candidate whose treatment PC-JSON gate failed is recorded as UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED / unresolved, not counted as a capability failure (spec.decision_rule rule 2b/3). A comparator cell that CLEARS the bar is a confound (prompt effect not identifiable) and makes the packet MEASUREMENT_INVALID; lesser comparator deviations from the historical parent anchor are recorded as drift notes (see decision_rule).

baselines.description: M-7B-QWEN under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED (byte-identical to the parent's frozen system prompt; raw/harness_config.json file sha256 7aba9dc899c40dd29f87b4265835eea6dc0b889c66271a983e4b82b8f5bc7adb, prompts.system string sha256 1294954da7b1d6b9570b07e1e39cb48515b925355d0f33d5fabf72c8e8ce3876), run IN THIS EXPERIMENT through the same harness, artifacts, GBNF grammar and sampling schedule as its treatment cell, as a paired within-packet comparator controlling run-level environment drift. Frozen parent anchor (audit PASS): task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), and zero terminal answer actions across all 10 evaluated episodes (parent result.json#observations; the parent's answer_action_emission_rate metric field was null, so the zero-answer fact is established from the raw episode traces, not from a parent metric value).
baselines.expected_outcome: Fail the capability bar (task_success_rate < 0.6) with parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6, ideally reproducing the parent anchor (task_success_rate=0.0, parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0, zero answer actions). Exact anchor match is recorded as REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT; a bar-failing deviation that preserves parseability is recorded as REPLICATION_ANCHOR_DRIFT (validity note). A comparator that CLEARS the bar, or drops below parseable 0.6, is a hard invalidation.

baselines.description: M-3B-QWEN under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED; same paired-anchor logic as the 7B comparator. Frozen parent anchor: task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), zero terminal answer actions (parent result.json#observations).
baselines.expected_outcome: Fail the capability bar with parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 (target the exact parent anchor; deviations handled as for B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-7B).

baselines.description: Uniform random action selection from the frozen 5-action valid space (click #reveal-btn; answer TARGET-41; answer TARGET-42; answer TARGET-43; answer unknown), 5 episodes, seeded RNG random.Random(42) created once and reused across episodes (exactly as the parent's mode_null_random does), run against the SERVED task page through the same run_episode scorer as the candidates. NOTE: the parent measured this control on an un-navigated about:blank page (its null-random mode never navigates to the served port), which structurally forced click_ok=false and task_success=0; the parent's control_episodes.json therefore cannot certify the random baseline's true chance realization. This design repairs that control-sensitivity defect by navigating to the served page before the episodes. Analytic per-episode success probability = sum_{j=1..4} (1/5)^(j+1) = 0.04 + 0.008 + 0.0016 + 0.00032 = 0.04992, so P(task_success_rate >= 3/5) = P(Binomial(5, 0.04992) >= 3) ~ 1.15e-3 and the 0.6 bar is effectively unreachable by chance. Deterministic seed-42 realization (design-time simulation of the parent's exact one-draw-per-step rng.choice stream, non-outcome-bearing, re-derived at EXECUTE): episode 0 = click, click(hidden, click_ok=false), answer TARGET-42 -> success; episodes 1-3 = answer TARGET-41 first; episode 4 = click, answer unknown; hence task_success_rate = 1/5 = 0.2 and parseable_action_rate_step1 = 5/5 = 1.0.
baselines.expected_outcome: parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (valid JSON by construction); deterministic seed-42 task_success_rate = 0.2 (1/5), which is < 0.6. EXECUTE must reproduce (1.0, 0.2); a different realization indicates a driver/RNG-stream mismatch and is recorded explicitly (if task_success_rate >= 0.6 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID). The 0.6 bar is unreachable by chance.

baselines.description: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M (grandparent E-LOCAL-LLAMA). NOT re-run. Parent/grandparent evidence: emits prose with no parseable JSON action, 0/5.

Pollinations anonymous proxy (gpt-oss-20b), grandparent E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI. NOT re-run. Parent evidence: empty/reasoning-only content, ~197-token cap, intermittent HTTP 402, no SLA/pinning. Carried as the recorded fallback decision input if the local 3B-8B class yields the bounded negative.

positive_control.success_criterion: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 per evaluated cell; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight

members.protocol: 10 probes per cell (each candidate under BOTH prompt conditions): the frozen probe string 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}' under the cell's own prompts.system with the frozen GBNF grammar from raw/harness_config.json (grammar string sha256 16c9877c0829b2099bd7180c212f28d8c545b095e9a4411afa7cabccd3fa6a65; file sha256 7aba9dc899c40dd29f87b4265835eea6dc0b889c66271a983e4b82b8f5bc7adb).
members.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching the action schema (positive_control_pass_rate=1.0)
members.failure_policy: a cell whose PC fails is EXCLUDED (no episodes for that cell); if both candidates' treatment-cell PCs fail -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (decoding infrastructure failure, not model capability).

members.protocol: 5/5 scripted episodes (click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42) driven through the REAL run_episode scorer (imported from the frozen parent runner) against the served page, with navigation repaired.
members.success_criterion: 5/5 task_success=true (proves the scorer registers the full completion path and the mechanical verification is live)
members.failure_policy: <5/5 -> preflight failure -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (scorer broken, not model behavior).

null_control.protocol: 5 episodes of fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') through the real scorer against the SERVED task page (navigated)
null_control.failure_policy: any parseable or successful episode -> verification logic broken -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID

measurement_validity: Only prompts.system varies between treatment and comparator cells; the task, harness code path, GBNF grammar, user template, sampling schedule, seeds, model artifacts and environment are identical. Byte-identified at pre-freeze: P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED is the exact parent system string (sha256 1294954da7b1d6b9570b07e1e39cb48515b925355d0f33d5fabf72c8e8ce3876); P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (sha256 36a4240aba96e46797c16aebbedcc548778a0c1097b4ce4432608148758c5716) is the grandparent SYS string (sha256 742e5aae5b5ffd72ccb43cb18658a14483660e7659640df651e91011e9b6dc12) with the single ref->selector key alignment. Per-cell configs are materialized by loading the frozen parent harness_config.json and replacing ONLY prompts.system (prereg.md section 4.6), so every other config key is inherited byte-for-byte.

Deterministic protocol: temperature=0.0, llama_seed=42, episode seeds 42-46, max_tokens=512, n_ctx=2048, chat_format=qwen, n_threads=4. Parent traces were exactly uniform across episodes (audit VF-03); the 3/5 rule is the pre-declared adequacy rule for a capability gate, not a statistical threshold, and no variance estimate is possible from the design.

Controls (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE, NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION, B-RANDOM-ACTION) run against the SERVED task page through the same run_episode scorer as the candidates (navigation repaired relative to the parent's about:blank control defect), so a positive result is registerable by the scorer and a null result cannot be an artifact of a broken navigation.

Comparator cells are collected unconditionally for every evaluated candidate BEFORE any outcome decision; the identification contrast is the contemporaneous within-run pair (same run, same model, same everything except prompts.system). The frozen parent anchor (task_success_rate 0/5, parseable_action_rate_step1 5/5, zero answer actions) is an expected drift monitor: exact match -> REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT; bar-failing deviation with parseable >= 0.6 -> REPLICATION_ANCHOR_DRIFT (validity note, contrast remains identifiable). A comparator that clears the bar, or drops below parseable 0.6, is hard MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
Positive control gates each cell: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 before that cell's episodes; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight.

Cell completeness and exclusion (spec.decision_rule definitions): a cell is COMPLETE iff its PC-JSON gate passed and it recorded exactly clearing_threshold.episodes=5 episode records; EXCLUDED iff its PC-JSON gate did not pass (no episodes run). A partial cell (PC passed but fewer than 5 episode records) cannot decide a clearance or a confound -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not a scientific negative; a candidate whose treatment cell is EXCLUDED is unresolved, not counted as a capability failure.

Strict mechanical verification: Playwright DOM assertions + JSON-schema parse (identical parsing rule to parent: the whole completion must be valid JSON matching {action: click|answer, selector?: string, text?: string}); no LLM grading.

GGUF provisioning is fail-closed on digest: downloaded files must match the sha256 receipts pinned from research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/gguf_sha256.txt (same model, same quantization Q4_K_M); mismatch -> provisioning_failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (not model capability).

No prompt tuning, no model substitution, no post-freeze design changes. The treatment prompt leaks neither '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42' (verified at design time), so a treatment success cannot be attributed to answer leakage.

The treatment prompt is the ONLY new factor relative to the parent: the parent FALSIFIES ceiling (underspecified prompt) is superseded by the goal/schema protocol ceiling exactly as the Director's bounded-negative exit requires.

Grammar admission vs parse acceptance (self-attacked at design time): the frozen GBNF admits any single-field object whose keys are 'selector' or 'text' independent of the 'click'/'answer' action, so grammar-feasible completions include schema-mismatched objects (e.g. {"action":"answer","selector":...}) that the frozen parse_action rejects. Treatment liveness therefore rests on the empirically verified PC 10/10 and the comparator's 5/5 step-1 parseable behavior, NOT on the claim that every grammar-feasible output is parseable. A treatment cell whose parseable_action_rate_step1 falls below 0.6 fails the bar (it cannot clear), so this residual cannot manufacture a false SUPPORTS.

The new EXECUTE driver is a thin wrapper that IMPORTS parse_action/regex_parse_action/run_episode and the producer/control semantics from the frozen parent runner research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py and must not copy or re-implement them (the parent runner is a freeze artifact, so the outcome-determining parsing/scoring/episode logic is bound to its sha256). Its own content is bound by prereg.md Appendix A; its sha256 and the materialized per-cell config sha256 are recorded in provenance.json at EXECUTE. Per-cell configs are deterministic transformations of the frozen parent harness_config.json: load it and replace ONLY prompts.system with the condition string, so positive_control (probe string/count), null_control content, random_baseline 5-action space, task.page_html, gbnf_grammar, sampling and clearing_threshold are inherited byte-for-byte; no outcome-relevant config key is re-authored. The repaired controls driver must navigate the Playwright page to the served port before each control episode (the parent's about:blank control defect is not inherited).
decision_rule: OUTCOME in {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}; status=COMPLETE unless operational blockers prevent every cell. DEFINITIONS: a CELL is one (candidate, prompt-condition) unit = PC-JSON gate (10 probes; passed iff positive_control_pass_rate==1.0) + an episode batch (clearing_threshold.episodes=5). A cell is COMPLETE iff its PC gate passed AND it recorded exactly 5 episode records; EXCLUDED iff its PC gate did not pass (no episodes run); CLEARS iff COMPLETE and task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6; a comparator cell is VALID iff COMPLETE and task_success_rate<0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6. PRECEDENCE (first matching rule wins): (1) PREFLIGHT: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE==5/5 AND NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION==(parseable 0.0, success 0.0) AND B-RANDOM-ACTION==(parseable 1.0, task_success_rate<0.6) AND all freeze_artifact hash checks match AND required stack imports OK AND GGUF digest checks PASS; else OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. (2) CANDIDATE LOOP over [M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN] in order, each candidate measured in ONE run: (2a) run the TREAT cell (PC-JSON gate then 5 episodes) and run the COMP cell (PC-JSON gate then 5 episodes) unconditionally as a contemporaneous pair; (2b) if the TREAT cell is EXCLUDED, the candidate yields no capability measurement: record it UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED and continue to the next candidate (unresolved, NOT a failure); (2c) if either cell of the pair is COMPLETE-but-partial (fewer than 5 episode records) -> a partial pair cannot decide a clearance or a confound -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, STOP; (2d) if the COMP cell CLEARS (task_success_rate>=0.6) or has parseable_action_rate_step1<0.6 -> prompt effect not identifiable -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, STOP; otherwise record the comparator disposition (COMPLETE-and-VALID with task_success_rate=0.0 and parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 and zero answer actions -> REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT; any other VALID value -> REPLICATION_ANCHOR_DRIFT validity note); (2e) if the TREAT cell CLEARS -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS (attribution=PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED, candidate=c), STOP. (3) FALSIFIES: the loop completed, at least one TREAT cell was COMPLETE (measurable), no TREAT cell cleared, and every evaluated COMP cell was COMPLETE-and-VALID -> SUPPORTS is not observed for the measured candidate set (Director's bounded negative; candidates with an EXCLUDED treatment cell are listed in unresolved, not counted as failures). (4) Otherwise (no TREAT cell was measurable, e.g. all treatment PCs failed) -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. report.md must record, per evaluated candidate, the failure-mode descriptor (answer_action_emission_rate, click loop count, step-0 reveal success) and the bounded-negative wording exactly.
product_consequence_positive: If any candidate completes click-then-answer under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA while its contemporaneous comparator cell fails the bar (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED): audit VF-01's prompt-underspecification hypothesis is confirmed as the driver of the parent failure; the parent FALSIFIES is bounded to the underspecified-prompt ceiling and C-LLM-INHERIT readiness condition (3) is satisfied at mechanism level (a factory-provisionable programmatic endpoint can perform a minimal multi-step Web-agent task), so the frozen four-arm benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, same model/tools/budget) becomes executable with the verified goal/schema prompt as the in-prompt task specification. Whether C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL is a DIRECTOR adjudication, not a DESIGN or EXECUTE conclusion.
product_consequence_negative: If no measurable candidate clears under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (FALSIFIES = the Director's bounded negative at the prompt-ablated ceiling): the step-0-reveal re-click loop is NOT caused by missing instruction context at the 3B-8B Qwen class; the capability ceiling for credential-free CPU-quantized local models under this task/harness is real, readiness condition (3) is not satisfied by this model class, and the four-arm benchmark's credential-free path remains DESIGN_COMPROMISED. The recorded endpoint receipts (E-LOCAL-LLAMA, E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI tokens/SLA) and the re-scope set (drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor in favor of internally re-run comparators on a dynamic-range task bank; or provision a hosted endpoint with pinning/SLA; or pursue a different model class) become decision inputs for the Global Research Director; this packet does not pre-decide the re-scope. A MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome changes no claim and requires the recorded repair before any re-run.
estimated_cost: CPU-only (nproc=4, ~15 GB total RAM). Up to 2 candidates x (1 comparator cell + 1 treatment cell) x (10 PC probes + up to 5 episodes x up to 5 steps) llama.cpp inferences; parent measured mean latency 5.065 s/call (7B) and 2.154 s/call (3B) at 13-17 completion tokens/call, so inference is ~10-25 min worst case (early stop after the first clearing treatment cell). Provisioning: re-download ~6.8 GB GGUFs via the confirmed huggingface.co resolve-redirect route (URLs + sha256 pinned; verified live at design time: 3B 302, 7B split shard1 302, shard2 302, 7B single-file 404 as documented) ~20-45 min; llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 sdist build (cmake 3.31.6 + gcc/g++ 13.3 verified present; no cp312 wheel published) ~5-15 min; playwright install (Chrome present at /usr/bin/google-chrome) <5 min; controls/preflight <5 min. No external API spend. Wall-clock estimate 45-150 min.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in BOTH directions: this is the cheapest measurement that separates the two competing explanations audit VF-01/U-01/U-02 left open (prompt underspecification vs model capability/planning deficit) for the exact candidate pair, at the exact frozen protocol, with within-run paired comparators and fail-closed preflight. SUPPORTS unblocks the flagship four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark; FALSIFIES (bounded negative) closes the credential-free local 3B-8B path as a capability result (not a prompt artifact) and hands the Director the recorded receipts for the hosted-endpoint re-scope. This is readiness-condition-(3) work explicitly allocated by the Director's CONTINUE mandate and is NOT a census rerun or an economics claim (P2-REPLAY-COST guard applies only downstream: matched tasks and fully loaded counterfactual costs before any replay/economics claim).

candidates.note: Frozen single-file URL (qwen2.5-7b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf) returns HTTP 404 (parent-documented packaging deviation, raw/provisioning_evidence.json); the same-repo same-quant split shards are the pinned artifacts, digest-verified at download and loaded by passing shard1 as model_path (llama-cpp-python auto-locates the companion shard).
Single-file Q4_K_M; resolve URL verified live (HTTP 302) at design time.

P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply with ONLY a valid JSON action per the schema. No prose, no reasoning, no markdown.
P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED.provenance: Byte-identical to the frozen system prompt of the audited parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 (raw/harness_config.json#prompts.system; file sha256 7aba9dc899c40dd29f87b4265835eea6dc0b889c66271a983e4b82b8f5bc7adb, string sha256 1294954da7b1d6b9570b07e1e39cb48515b925355d0f33d5fabf72c8e8ce3876). This is the comparator condition; its parent cell outcome (0/5) is the frozen expected anchor, re-measured contemporaneously in this packet.

P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply ONLY with one JSON object per turn, no prose. Actions available: {"action":"click","selector":"<id>"} or {"action":"answer","text":"<code>"}. Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.
P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA.provenance: Derived from the grandparent harness SYS constant in research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37973264582/raw/code/min_webagent.py (file sha256 4e2b6710c78f4e4399a8ed5ae78e0231563fb832b780b80a955bcbc16b046862; SYS string sha256 742e5aae5b5ffd72ccb43cb18658a14483660e7659640df651e91011e9b6dc12) with a single ref->selector schema alignment (adapted treatment string sha256 36a4240aba96e46797c16aebbedcc548778a0c1097b4ce4432608148758c5716). Justification: the parent task's frozen GBNF admits only the keys 'selector' and 'text'; the grandparent prompt's 'ref' key is not in the grammar. The alignment makes the prompt's named schema match the grammar-enforced schema so the treatment measures the goal+schema content rather than a prompt/grammar key mismatch. Adds exactly the two dimensions audit VF-01 says the parent prompt lacked: (a) enumeration of the action schema and (b) the task goal sentence 'Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.' Does NOT leak '#reveal-btn' or 'TARGET-42' (verified at design time).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every outcome is arithmetically reachable and no branch is empty or shadowed. SUPPORTS requires a COMPLETE treatment cell >= 3/5 task_success, which the PC-ORACLE-EPISODE canary (5/5 through the real scorer, deterministic scripted actions) proves the scorer can register; the treatment cell outcome is empirically open (the whole point of the ablation). FALSIFIES requires the loop to complete with at least one COMPLETE treatment cell clearing nothing and every evaluated comparator COMPLETE-and-VALID; the parent realized exactly the comparator behavior (0/5) and neither candidate is guaranteed to clear, so this branch is reachable. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via preflight failure (rule 1), comparator clearing the bar / losing parseability (rule 2d), a partial pair (rule 2c), or no measurable treatment cell (rule 4). The threshold 0.6 over 5 episodes (k in 0..5, k>=3) is fully attainable for both outcomes. Precedence 1..4 has no unreachable later rule: rule 2 executes only if rule 1 did not fire; rule 3 fires exactly when at least one treatment cell was COMPLETE, none cleared, and all evaluated comparators were COMPLETE-and-VALID; rule 4 covers the residual no-measurable-treatment case. Early stop at 2e cannot shadow comparator validity because the comparator cell is collected unconditionally before any decision (2a). Each cell is a 5-element deterministic vector, and the parent already realized both extremes (0/5 task success and 5/5 step-1 parseable).

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is verified at DESIGN time or pinned to a frozen, previously-satisfied contract with fail-closed verification. (a) Stack assemblable in this factory (design-time probe): Python 3.12.15, pip 26.2.1, cmake 3.31.6 + gcc/g++ 13.3 + Python.h present (llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 has a PyPI sdist and no cp312 wheel, so the sdist build path is required and feasible); Chrome symlink /usr/bin/google-chrome present; CPU-only nproc=4, ~15 GB total RAM (parent loaded the 7B split shards under these constraints). llama-cpp-python and playwright are NOT preinstalled, so EXECUTE installs/builds them. (b) GBNF grammar well-formed: all 7 rules (root, ws, action, field, string, strchars, strchar) are defined and referenced (checked at design time); the grammar was constructible and executed by the parent. (c) Model URLs verified live at design time via the confirmed resolve-redirect route: 3B HTTP 302, 7B shard1 302, shard2 302, 7B single-file 404 (parent-documented packaging deviation), with sha256 pinned from raw/gguf_sha256.txt (digest mismatch -> provisioning_failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID). (d) Harness and fixture are bound repo files (freeze_artifacts) whose parsing/episode/verification logic was executed end-to-end by the audited parent; the run_episode scorer and control-producer semantics are inherited verbatim via import. (e) The serving page and Playwright flow were proven by the parent (task_episodes.json). The only EXECUTE-time creations - GGUF re-download, per-cell configs materialized by the deterministic overlay in prereg section 4.6, and the thin harness delta - are fully determined by frozen identifiers/digests and prereg text.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and comparator differ ONLY in prompts.system (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA vs P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED, byte-diffed at design time); all other protocol dimensions - task page HTML, GBNF grammar, user template, sampling schedule, seeds, model artifacts, harness code path - are identical, so any difference in task_success_rate / parseable_action_rate_step1 / answer_action_emission_rate between paired cells is attributable to the prompt, or to detectably-broken infrastructure caught by the fail-closed preflight and comparator-validity checks. The measurement range is non-degenerate: the same scorer registers 5/5 at the top (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE) and the parent produced 0/5 task success at the bottom under the comparator prompt, with the comparator sitting mid-range on parseability (5/5). The random baseline is confined strictly below the bar (deterministic seed-42 realization = 0.2 success, 1.0 parseable; analytic per-episode probability 0.04992, so P(bar cleared by chance) ~ 1.15e-3). Cost observables (latency, tokens) are descriptive per cell and identical in kind for both arms. The comparator cells are not 'negative-only memories': they are re-measured in this packet, making the attribution contrast contemporaneous with the treatment, with exactly 5 episodes per evaluated cell.

control_sensitivity.reason: All controls run against the SERVED task page through the SAME run_episode scorer as the candidates (navigation repaired relative to the parent's about:blank control defect, which structurally zeroed the parent's random baseline). PC-ORACLE-EPISODE (5 scripted click-then-answer episodes) fires 5/5 task_success=true, proving the positive control fires and the completion path is registerable; PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING fired 10/10 for both models in the audited parent under the identical grammar and probe, and is re-verified per cell at EXECUTE; NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION (fixed non-JSON content) stays 0/5 parseable and 0/5 success (verification rejects non-JSON); B-RANDOM-ACTION is parseable 5/5 by construction and its deterministic seed-42 task_success_rate is 0.2 (< 0.6), computed at design time from the parent's exact one-draw-per-step rng.choice stream and re-derived at EXECUTE, so the bar is effectively unreachable by chance and the control cannot accidentally clear it. No control is tautological (none contains the target answer supplied to the model) or structurally impossible (all have non-empty, attainable expected outcomes distinct from the treatment outcome space). Distinct controls cover decoding, scoring, null rejection, and chance-level task success.
